Version History

1.X
1.5.X INITIAL RELEASE
v1.5.0 - 27 February 2024
  • Adds Gronckles, Deadly Nadders, Monstrous Nightmares, and Hideous Zipplebacks
    • Includes sitting, riding, flying, and shooting behavior
  • Adds Dragon Hunter Ships and Hunter Watchtowers
    • Includes Dragon Cages and Dragon Hunters
  • Adds Book of Dragons with an entry for each dragon
  • Changes chicken model to be more HTTYD-esque
HOTFIX
v1.5.1 - 28 February 2024
  • Fixes dragons not sitting
  • Fixes Zipplebacks not having variants
HOTFIX
v1.5.2 - 13 August 2024
  • Fixes issues caused by the removal of the Holiday Creator Features
  • Adds the long-awaited Night Fury! No Book of Dragons entry yet.
1.6.X MINOR VERSION
v1.6.0 - 19 August 2024
  • Adds Whispering Deaths
  • Adds breeding, baby dragons, and eggs for all dragons except night furies
  • Adds Book of Dragons entries for the Night Fury and Whispering Death
  • Adds achievements in a separate pack. For now, only available in English. Translation to Portuguese is planned.
  • Fixes many bugs
HOTFIX
v1.6.1 - 19 August 2024
  • Fixes an issue where dragons were hard to train because they were often high in the sky. They should now land more frequently.
  • Partially fixed an issue where Whispering Deaths would sometimes float into the sky when attacked. They should not do this as often.
HOTFIX
v1.6.2 - 20 August 2024
  • Fixes an lack of animations for most baby dragons.
  • Fixes an issue where most dragons would sometimes float into the sky when attacked.
1.7.X MINOR VERSION
v1.7.0 - 27 August 2024
  • Adds Thunderdrums. No Book of Dragons entry yet
  • Adds sounds for many dragons
  • Adds the Dragon Blade and Monstrous Nightmare Gel
  • Fixes many bugs
1.8.X MINOR VERSION
v1.8.0 - 6 September 2024
  • Adds Sand Wraiths. No Book of Dragons entry yet
  • Adds new attack animation for Thunderdrums
  • Adds new pottery sherd (Tame) that is found in Watchtowers
  • Updates the Watchtower loot to include newer items and more dragon eggs
  • Updates some dragon flying and fleeing behavior
  • Fixes many bugs
1.9.X MINOR VERSION
v1.9.0 - 4 November 2024
  • Adds Timberjacks. No Book of Dragons entry yet
  • Adds new egg models for a few dragons
  • Adds dragon horns, which can be used to call all trained dragons within your render distance to your location
  • Updates some baby dragon models and animations
  • Updates the night fury model
  • Updates saddle models for a few dragons
  • Fixes many bugs
  • The add-on now requires a new experimental toggle. Check out the download page for more information.
1.10.X MINOR VERSION
v1.10.0 - 11 November 2024
  • Adds Skrills and Flame Whippers. No Book of Dragons entry yet
  • Updates and fixes night fury animations
  • Adds new settings toggle for camera positioning while flying a dragon. It will default to first person, but you can change it anytime
  • Adds baby Night Furies and Night Fury eggs.
  • Fixes many bugs
HOTFIX
v1.10.1 - 14 November 2024
  • Fixes Thunderdrum spawning rates
  • Updates Skrill textures
  • Updates tame pottery sherd to be more consistent with other sherds
  • Updates the Book of Dragons to have all current dragons
1.11.X MINOR VERSION
v1.11.0 - 22 November 2024
  • Added the snow wraith, which can be tamed as a baby. No Book of Dragons entry yet.
  • Updated Monstrous Nightmare animations
  • Fixed Sand Wraiths not growing up. May only fix new sand wraiths. Pre-existing sand wraiths may not be fixed.
  • Fixed lag caused by Thunderdrums
  • Fixed dragon flight to not only go up
  • Fixed several other bugs
HOTFIX
v1.11.1 - 24 November 2024
  • Dragons spawn less frequently, allowing for normal mobs to spawn more often
  • Reworked dragon fireballs, to allow to better performance
  • Reworked dragon cages. Skrills and sand wraiths can now be found in them as well!
  • Players can no longer remove saddles from dragons that are not tamed by them
  • Monstrous Nightmares will no longer T-Pose when sitting
  • Added Book of Dragons entry for the Snow Wraith
HOTFIX
v1.11.2 - 24 November 2024
  • Removed developer code that filled the chat with numbers when a night fury was eligible to spawn
1.12.X MINOR VERSION
v1.12.0 - 5 December 2024
  • Additions
  • Added Hobblegrunts, Rumblehorns, Night Lights, Light Furies, and Buffalords
  • Hobblegrunts, Rumblehorns, and Buffalords spawn naturally
  • Light Furies can be found in Dragon Cages.
  • Night Lights can be obtained by breeding a Light Fury and Night Fury, and they never grow up
  • Buffalords are untrainable and have no egg. They just want to eat grass
  • Book of Dragons entries are available for all five
  • Added a new special variant dragon: the Pale Nightmare. They spawn in Pale Gardens
  • Added a new seasonal variant dragon, the Icy Gronckle. They spawn in Icy biomes during December
  • Added diving ability, which can be activated by looking down past 65°
  • Changes
  • Overhauled Hunter Watchtowers, which will now spawn less frequently, have better loot, and blend with terrain better.
  • Removed Control Scheme Option in Settings. The code now detects this itself. You can still change Camera Perspective there.
  • Dragon Hunters now attack players on sight, instead of only once attacked.
  • Fixes
  • Dragons should no longer despawn when tamed.
  • Dragon Cages no longer fall out of Hunter Ships.
  • Parts of Hunter Ships are no longer waterlogged.
  • Dragon Hunters now have better animations.
  • Reworked dragon cages... again. They are now less buggy.
  • Players no longer have collision with other players.
  • Nightmare wings no longer rotate strangely.
2.X MAJOR VERSION
v2.0 - 17 June 2025
  • Additions
  • Added Typhoomerangs, Hobgobblers, Screaming Deaths, and Death Songs
    • Added Amber Blasts as the Death Song fire type. Amber Blasts will freeze players and some entities in place for about 40 seconds. Interacting with the Amber Chunk using Monstrous Nightmare Gel will coat it in gel. Lighting the gel with Flint and Steel, a Fire Charge, or the Dragon Blade will destroy the amber and free the entity or player.
    • Added Amber Blasts as the Death Song fire type. Amber Blasts will freeze players and some entities in place for about 40 seconds. Interacting with the Amber Chunk using Monstrous Nightmare Gel will coat it in gel. Lighting the gel with Flint and Steel, a Fire Charge, or the Dragon Blade will destroy the amber and free the entity or player.
    • Book of Dragons entries are available for all four
  • Added Boneknapper and Sentinel Bosses, and their Trained Variants
    • Book of Dragons entries are available for both
  • Added the Red Death Boss
    • A Book of Dragons is available for it
  • Added the Boss Fight Structures for Sentinels, Boneknappers, and Red Deaths
  • Added the Death Song Nests
  • Added the Dragon Eye and Dragon Eye Lenses
    • The Dragon Eye can be found on the Captain's Table of Dragon Hunter Ships
    • Some Dragon Eye Lenses can be found in boss structures. Others can be found in Dragon Hunter Ships
    • Interacting with the Dragon Eye while holding a Lens will drop the current Lens if there is one and insert the new one. Breaking the Dragon Eye or interacting with something other than a Lens will drop the Current Lens.
  • Added Dragon Scales for the five main dragons. These will be dropped by trained dragons occassionally, and will gain a use in the future.
  • Added Night Fury Tail Fins, which can be equipped on Night Furies for further customization
    • The "Toothless" name Easter Egg has also been removed. Use the Red Night Fury Tail Fin to achieve the same effect.
  • Added Saddle Bags, which act like a bundle and can be equipped to your dragon.
  • Added Incubation Pedestals. Dragon eggs will no longer hatch unless they are placed on a pedestal that has been filled with lava.
  • Added Dragon Name Tags. These specialized name tags will open the dragon naming menu that is opened upon training a dragon.
    • Dev Note: This is both a solution to the issue in which some dragons couldn't be renamed, and a way to make naming dragons more accessible. These name tags are craftable and do not need an anvil to be used.
  • Changes
  • Changed Hideous Zippleback and Deadly Nadder models to be more accurate
  • Added sounds for a few more dragons
  • Overhauled Dragon Hunter Ships
    • They contain more hunters, more dragons to rescue, and more loot.
  • Overhauled Night Fury spawning
    • Night Furies will now have approximately a 12% chance to spawn near a random player during an unskipped night (1.2% per minute of night) if there is not an untamed night fury near that player.
    • Dev Note: The old method of spawning night furies made them a little too rare, because only one could exist in a world at once. This new method makes it take the same amount of time to spawn one, but doesn't limit the number of night furies spawned. They will spawn regardless of the number of night furies in the world, as long as there aren't any near the player.
  • Fixes
  • Fixed Ice Gronckle not being spawnable using a spawn egg except during December
  • Fixed Dragon Hunter Arrows not making your dragon flightless
    • Dev Note: The intention has always been that being hit by a dragon hunter's arrow would prevent your dragon from flying for several seconds. This hasn't worked for a long time, but is now working again.
